articles.title: New DeFi entrant widens field of crypto political campaign funds as elections loom
articles.snippet: The Defend Developers PAC is aiming to contribute to lawmakers who seek to shield crypto developers from legal vulnerabilities.

articles.title: Payment giants Stripe, Visa, Mastercard said to be among backers of soon-to-debut stablecoin platform
articles.snippet: U.S. crypto exchange Coinbase is also said to be looking into the possibility of participating in the new stablecoin platform.

articles.title: Bitcoin steadies at $67,000, faces critical juncture after sliding 9.5% in seven days
articles.snippet: The recovery does little to mask a 9.5% weekly decline as U.S. stocks hit records highs, AI tokens rally and Coinbase's Ethena deal steals the spotlight.

articles.title: Trezor says Safe 7 chip flaw found by Ledger does not put funds at risk
articles.snippet: Trezor and Tropic Square disclosed a TROPIC01 chip vulnerability found during a Ledger Donjon audit, saying the Safe 7 wallet and user funds remain secure.

articles.title: US lawmakers push back on Labor Department plans to include crypto in 401(k)s
articles.snippet: The three members of Congress said the volatility of digital assets and “lack of regulation and safeguards” could put Americans’ retirement savings at risk.
